short_prompt:
Use $scene-layout-forge to create ONE finished PNG in a fresh numbered folder under the current project's output directory.
Complex industrial service hall: six vessels in three modules, three pumps and exactly six helmeted workers. Supported beams, braces, ducts, cable trays and cabinets supply architecture at several heights. Use this as a connectivity starting point, not a mandatory frontal composition. Inspect camera occlusions and develop a project-specific interior with depth before final art. Four English leader callouts identify storage vessels, a circulation pump, a maintenance platform and a cable tray.
Use the skill's written art direction without requiring any reference images: fine neutral graphite and thin ink, near-white subtly ivory paper, meaningful architectural detail, selective hatching and atmospheric depth. Avoid yellow/sepia and glossy 3D.
Read the nearest bundled example as a starting point; build and validate project-local geometry, inspect it, then apply the artistic finish. The example renderer only creates a guide, not the finished artistic image. Inspect the actual generated image and its label arrows. Allow at most two targeted corrections. Report unresolved issues.
After verifying final.png opens, retain all inputs, models, guides, prompts, variants and reviews in project history. Deliver one selected PNG and report its history location, dimensions, revision and limitations. No automatic deletion.

Before finishing, read references/art-direction.md and use its explicit handoff: subject-specific detail map, three line weights, neutral tone, hand-lettered English callouts and unambiguous arrow tips. Preserve any explicit view; otherwise choose freely without importing this example camera. Review style separately from counts, and use references/mechanical-coherence.md when motion or force is implied.

Apply references/context-composition.md: respect the explicit view and any isolated-study intent in this example; otherwise choose restrained context and a useful view. Treat example geometry/camera as adaptable patterns, not defaults for unrelated subjects. Plan meaningful variety without altering required counts or functional symmetry; inspect final context separately from detail.
